description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans cluster liveness using ZooKeeper as the membership provider. It defines a test class 'LivenessTests_ZK' that configures a test cluster with ZooKeeper, and includes multiple test methods for different liveness scenarios.

classes.name: LivenessTests_ZK
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans cluster liveness with ZooKeeper, inheriting from LivenessTestsBase.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo to use ZooKeeper clustering with specified connection string.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with ZooKeeper configuration.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_1
methods.description: Test for basic liveness oracle with ZooKeeper.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_2_Restart_Primary
methods.description: Test for restarting the primary silo and verifying liveness.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_3_Restart_GW
methods.description: Test for restarting the gateway and verifying liveness.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_4_Restart_Silo_1
methods.description: Test for restarting silo 1 and verifying liveness.

methods.name: Liveness_ZooKeeper_5_Kill_Silo_1_With_Timers
methods.description: Test for killing silo 1 with timers and verifying liveness.
